evidence.observation: David did what was right in the LORD’s eyes and did not turn aside from anything commanded all his life, except in the matter of Uriah.
David’s heart struck him after he had counted the people, and he told the LORD that he had sinned greatly.

record.tension: The royal summary names Uriah as its exception while David’s census confession explicitly names another act as great sin.
record.title: How does the royal evaluation sit beside the census confession?
